The main takeaway from our work is that

the α1-microalbumin/creatinine (α1-M/creatinine) ratio upon presentation with acute pancreatitis is related to inflammation (as measured by high-sensitivity C reactive protein 48 h later) and predicts development of pancreatic organ failure.
